data.title: Amended income tax assessment 2025 – additional refund €212.40
data.summary: The Finanzamt Neu-Beispielstadt amended the 2025 income tax assessment of 14 August 2026 because you submitted the donation receipt late. This results in a further refund of €212.40.
data.explanation: The tax office changed your 2025 income tax assessment after you submitted the donation receipt (Zuwendungsbestätigung) for your gift to the animal welfare association. You get an extra refund of €212.40. No payment is needed from you. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or on record at the tax office; the app shows the deadline. Check that the refund arrives in your bank account. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
data.tax_note: Amended income tax assessment for 2025 that recognises a donation (Spende) and increases the refund.
